title: MOOR Capability Crystallizer + Assembly Memory
page0: Does every MOOR blueprint/build leave behind enough deterministic structure to be reassembled without an LLM and enough verified typed capability data for the environment to become more capable over time? If not, derive the correct questions, build the system, and push it to Pulse.
correctedQuestion: How does every blueprint and verified build automatically crystallize into deterministic assembly instructions, a verified typed capability delta, and machine-extrapolatable composition data so MOOR can reuse more work without invoking an LLM?
materialQuestions: What exact artifact must survive so the result can be reconstructed without interpreting natural language?
Which operations in reconstruction are deterministic, and which require an executor that must be explicitly named?
What capability was actually verified—not merely intended?
What typed inputs, outputs, controls, state, side effects and compatibility constraints does that capability expose?
What evidence proves each capability and what remains unverified?
Which existing verified capabilities can connect to this one by type/contract compatibility?
Which new connections are only hypotheses, and what deterministic test would promote each hypothesis?
What failures, substitutions and constraints must future builds inherit so they do not rediscover the same mistake?
What can be compacted while preserving exact assembly and auditability?
How does Pulse expose this as a living capability/assembly graph rather than another document archive?

answer.thesis: Every blueprint/build emits a Crystal Bundle. Verified bundles enter a typed Capability Graph. Deterministic compatibility produces candidate composition edges. Verification promotes useful compositions into reusable packages. Natural-language reasoning becomes a fallback instead of the default glue.

assemblyContract.purpose: Exact reconstruction plan requiring no natural-language interpretation.
assemblyContract.operationRule: Every step names a deterministic op and arguments. Unknown ops stop with MISSING_EXECUTOR; the assembler never improvises.
assemblyContract.executorModel: Runtimes register executors such as set/merge/append/register-package/mount-url/emit/run-check/materialize-file. The contract is portable; authority to perform external writes remains runtime-scoped.
assemblyContract.determinism: Same contract + same versioned inputs + same executors must produce the same declared output state, excluding explicitly declared nondeterministic sources.

capabilityDelta.purpose: Describe only what the artifact can now demonstrably do.
capabilityDelta.promotion: Only verification evidence may promote a capability to machine-verified; model confidence cannot.

learningCapsule.purpose: Compact reusable lessons without confusing history with law.
learningCapsule.retention: Keep authority/evidence hashes and representative failures permanently by policy; discard disposable reasoning traces after compaction.

compositionGraph.verifiedNodes: Capabilities with machine-verified or human-approved evidence.
compositionGraph.candidateEdges: Mechanically inferred when output/input types, compatibility constraints and side-effect policies match.
compositionGraph.candidateLaw: Candidate edges are explicitly unverified and may be used only in experiments until their declared tests pass.
compositionGraph.promotion: A successful deterministic integration test emits evidence and converts the candidate edge into a verified composition/package.

triggerPoints.action: Crystallize the blueprint immediately as specified capability/assembly data; status remains specified until implementation verification.
Crystallize implementation recipe + evidence; promote actual proven capabilities to machine-verified.
Index Crystal Bundle, connect it to source artifact/evidence, update Capability Graph, infer candidate compatible edges.

automaticLoop: Passing composition becomes reusable verified package
Future Funnel/Harness lookup prefers verified capabilities/packages before new reasoning

canDoWithoutLLM: reassemble a known contract when executors exist
stillMayNeedIntelligence: resolve semantic ambiguity not encoded in types/contracts
design new behavior when no capability/package exists
noLLMBoundary.rule: The system must expose exactly why intelligence is needed instead of silently invoking it.

acceptance: Ultra Funnel issues a verifiable BlueprintReceipt and ExecutionReceipt for this build.
A known AssemblyContract can be executed without an LLM when all required executors are registered.
Unknown assembly operations fail explicitly with MISSING_EXECUTOR.
A verified build produces a CapabilityDelta linked to verification evidence.
Typed compatibility can infer candidate composition edges without an LLM.
Candidate edges cannot be mislabeled verified.
A passing declared integration test can promote a candidate composition to verified.
Blueprint-ready events automatically create specified Crystal Bundles.
Harness promoted outputs automatically create machine-verified Crystal Bundles.
Pulse exposes the Capability Memory project and its graph.
